description: Defines the 'processor_notifier_adaptor' class which acts as an adapter for various processor notifications related to the lower physical layer in a radio communication system. It includes nested classes for specific processor adaptors handling downlink, uplink, PRACH, PUSCH, and PDCCH notifications.

classes.name: processor_notifier_adaptor
classes.description: An adapter class that consolidates various processor notification interfaces for the lower physical layer, including downlink, uplink, PRACH, PUSCH, and PDCCH.

classes.name: downlink_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing downlink_processor_notifier, handling TTI boundary and metrics updates.

classes.name: uplink_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing uplink_processor_notifier, handling half-slot, full-slot, and metrics notifications.

classes.name: pdxch_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing pdxch_processor_notifier, handling late PDCCH requests.

classes.name: prach_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing prach_processor_notifier, handling PRACH request late, overflow, and reception events.

classes.name: puxch_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing puxch_processor_notifier, handling late PUSCH requests and received symbols.
